Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887. The work landed under the duplicate ticket aec1-76e7-bb95-4c86 ('LLM gate runs record no per-run request or tool-call counts', closed), commit ff4c56007a 'aec1: record the run shape a gate call computes'. Linked d166 -duplicates-> aec1. Ticked all 6 ACs after re-verifying each on main:

- AC1 (durable record without a pre-set env var): src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py _resolve_sink now has TWO sources — REBAR_USAGE_LOG wins if set, else the DEFAULT GATE SINK <repo root>/.rebar/usage.jsonl whenever in_gate_session() is true and .rebar/ already exists. Pinned by tests/unit/test_usage_log_run_shape_aec1.py::test_a_gate_run_records_with_no_env_var_set, with the no-surprise-writes guard pinned by test_a_non_gate_run_still_writes_nothing_when_unset.
- AC2 (tool_calls alongside requests): _SHAPE_FIELDS at usage_log.py:50-57 is (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, request_limit, tool_calls_limit, finish_reason), written alongside the _FIELDS counters that carry requests. test_the_success_row_records_the_tool_call_shape_too.
- AC3 (both outcomes): the shape reducer run_shape is reused verbatim by the success and failure paths (usage_log.py:162-169), and every row carries an explicit outcome key (OUTCOME_OK / OUTCOME_FAILED, record_failure at usage_log.py:547-552). test_the_exhaustion_row_records_the_tool_calls_it_burned (failure) + test_the_success_row_records_the_tool_call_shape_too (success).
- AC4 (attributable to ticket and gate): every row carries op (the gate that ran) and, when supplied, ticket. test_both_paths_record_wall_clock_duration_and_the_ticket asserts row['ticket'] == 'aec1-76e7-bb95-4c86' on BOTH paths.
- AC5 (privacy contract unchanged): run_shape's docstring and code reduce each tool call to a (tool_name, sha256(args)[:8]) SIGNATURE — prompts, response text, tool arguments and tool results are never recorded. The row is counters, limits, a finish_reason, timestamps and hashed signatures only.
- AC6 (test pins a retrievable record with requests and tool_calls): test_a_loop_and_a_breadth_run_are_separable_from_the_record_alone plus the retrieval-rendering tests in the same file.

Verified now: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_usage_log_run_shape_aec1.py tests/unit/test_usage_log.py tests/unit/test_usage_log_failed_calls.py -q -> 40 passed.
